summary: This page lists police stations in {district}, crime figures reported to the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) and monthly traffic fine collections, where we have them. Every figure shows its year or date and its source.
emptyBody: We are collecting crime data from NCRB (National Crime Records Bureau) and traffic revenue data. NCRB publishes district-level data once a year.
explainMet: In {month}, the traffic police collected ₹{amount} lakh in fines. The target for the month was ₹{target} lakh, so the target was met.
explainPart: In {month}, the traffic police collected ₹{amount} lakh in fines. The target for the month was ₹{target} lakh, so about {pct}% of the target was reached.
pictoMet: Every rupee of the {month} target was collected.
pictoPart: About {n} of every 10 rupees of the {month} target were collected.
crimeUnits: Number of cases recorded in each category.
crimeUnitsTotal: Number of cases recorded in each category. The total bar already includes the other categories.
crimeSimple: The largest figure is {name}, with {n, plural, one {{count} case} other {{count} cases}}.
trendUnits: Cases in the same category in {prev} and in the latest year on file. Only categories recorded in both years are shown.
trendSimple: Cases went up in {up} of {n} {n, plural, one {category} other {categories}} between {prev} and {latest}.
trafficUnits: Thousand rupees collected from traffic challans each month.
trafficSimple: The highest month on file is {month}, with ₹{amount} thousand collected.
tableCaption: Crime statistics by year and category
